items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Hoagy Carmichael wrote 'Kind Of Lonesome'... I sang 'Kind Of Lonesome' with Nat King Cole still in the background.

ctx.x: Okay. Two of these songs from December of 38 were from the movies that you made that year.

Yes. 'Kind Of Lonesome' is from St. Louis Blues. I think I mentioned before that after they padded my part in the movie, Hoagy Carmichael wrote 'Kind Of Lonesome', and there was a scene that sort of linked some of the bigger scenes together in which I sang 'Kind Of Lonesome' with Nat King Cole still in the background.
